ANCHOR_SPOOL_DESC: Places a Silk anchor on your position that you can travel back to.
BEAST_HOOK_DESC:
The power of the Warrior Beastfly courses through this Tool.

Provides lifesteal when you are on critical Health at the cost of some Silk. Has a cooldown of 15 seconds.
DRIFTER_WINGS_DESC:
Fayforn blessed Drifter's Cloak.

Will provide a slight uplift when used that allows you to reach new heights.
FAYDOWN_CLASP_DESC:
A Clasp made to honor the Fayforn.

A second set of wings can be used after triggering Clawline in the air.
LASTSTITCH_BAND_DESC:
Citadel technology at its best.

Silk Binding is 70% faster when in low health.
LIFELINE_SPOOL_DESC:
Has the power of protecting its bearer but will take from them as well.

Damage is reduced to a minimum at the cost of Silk.
SILKSEED_DESC:
A small Seed that generates Silk constantly.

Increases Silk maximum regeneration.
SNAIL_BADGE_DESC:
Protection granted by the Snail Shamans.

Will protect you from all damage an enemy would deal to you, but it takes some time to recharge.
ARCHITECT_SEAL_DESC:
A Seal granted by the Architects.

Your Tools become more powerful in detriment of your Needle.
COURIER_CHARM_DESC:
A lucky backpack once worn by Tipp.

Helps preserving the items you carry.
HAGGLER_MASK_DESC:
Looks like someone you know... or knew.

Shop owners seem charmed by your presence.
SHAKRA_BEADS_DESC:
Beads once worn by young Shakra.

Helps you get the lay of the land.
SHERMA_CHIME_DESC:
After her Pilgrimage, Sherma decided to gift these.

Sometimes you'll get guidance, specially when a tune accompanies you.
WOVEN_TOOLS_DESC:
Tools can be threaded by Silk to empower them.

Your tools become stronger if you have full Silk Spools.
SILKSTEP_DESC: A small Silk platform forms under your feet and enables you to jump on it on the air.
STILLTHREAD_DESC: Silk pumps through you and makes you faster, so you view the world slower.
